fib: ______ is a process of achieving specified objectives.
Planning
Planning is a process of achieving specified objectives.
______ is used to cast forward the past performance into the future.
Forecasting
Forecasting is used to cast forward the past performance into the future.
______ is an active participant in long -range financial planning.
Treasurer
The Treasurer is an active participant in long -range financial planning.
______ is a tool to avoid excessive and inadequate levels of inventories and maintain sufficient inventory for the smooth operations of the enterprise in terms of production and sales output.
Inventory management

Inventory management is a tool to avoid excessive and inadequate levels of inventories and maintain sufficient inventory for the smooth operations of the enterprise in terms of production and sales output.
______ are called shareholders/stockholders and they are the legal-owners of the business whose shares they hold.
Buyers of shares
Buyers of shares are called shareholders/stockholders and they are the legal-owners of the business whose shares they hold.
______ may be defined as the provision of money at the time it is required.
Finance
Finance may be defined as the provision of money at the time it is required.
______ is the retained portion of profits.
retention ratio
The retention ratio is the retained portion of profits.
______ is the risk which is borne by the seller.
time lag
The time lag is the risk which is borne by the seller.
______ is the common denominator for the full range of activities performed in the business.
Money
Money is the common denominator for the full range of activities performed in the business.
______ is used for two purposes, namely: definitive purpose and information purpose.
Financial statement analysis
Financial statement analysis is used for two purposes, namely: definitive purpose and information purpose.
